```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

## Setup

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(DHARMa)
library(ThemePark)
```

## Data

```{r data-generation}
set.seed(42)

n_per_cell <- 6

params <- tribble(
  ~strain,          ~diet,   ~mu,   ~size,
  "empty_vector",   "AL",    285,   18,
  "empty_vector",   "EODF",  195,   15,
  "daf",            "AL",    225,   14,
  "daf",            "EODF",  185,   12
)

block_effects <- tibble(
  block = 1:5,
  block_offset = c(0.05, -0.08, 0.12, -0.04, -0.05)
)

celegans_repro <- params |>
  crossing(block = 1:5) |>
  left_join(block_effects, by = "block") |>
  mutate(mu_adj = mu * exp(block_offset)) |>
  uncount(n_per_cell) |>
  mutate(
    worm_id         = row_number(),
    block           = factor(block),
    strain          = factor(strain, levels = c("empty_vector", "daf")),
    diet            = factor(diet,   levels = c("AL", "EODF")),
    total_offspring = rnbinom(n(), mu = mu_adj, size = size)
  ) |>
  select(worm_id, block, strain, diet, total_offspring) |>
  arrange(block, strain, diet)
```

## Descriptive summary

```{r summary}
celegans_repro |>
  group_by(strain, diet) |>
  summarise(
    n    = n(),
    mean = round(mean(total_offspring), 1),
    sd   = round(sd(total_offspring), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Models

We fit a generalised linear mixed model with a negative binomial response (appropriate for overdispersed counts), a `strain * diet` interaction, and `block` as a random intercept.

```{r models}
m_full <- glmer.nb(
  total_offspring ~ strain * diet + (1 | block),
  data = celegans_repro
)

m_additive <- glmer.nb(
  total_offspring ~ strain + diet + (1 | block),
  data = celegans_repro
)

m_null <- glmer.nb(
  total_offspring ~ 1 + (1 | block),
  data = celegans_repro
)
```

## Model comparison

```{r model-comparison}
AIC(m_null, m_additive, m_full)
anova(m_additive, m_full)
```

## Full model summary

```{r model-summary}
summary(m_full)
```

## Model diagnostics

```{r diagnostics, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
simulateResiduals(m_full, plot = TRUE)
```

## Post-hoc contrasts

```{r posthoc}
emmeans(m_full, pairwise ~ strain * diet, type = "response")
```

## Plot

```{r plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
ggplot(celegans_repro, aes(x = diet, y = total_offspring, colour = strain)) +
  geom_jitter() +
  geom_boxplot() +
  ThemePark::theme_barbie()
```
